scope: Finite real Graph multi-row speculative probability/conditional assembly and host selected-prefix conformance, not full-model statistical quality or performance.
product_change: Pure extraction of original prepare_prefix_sampling cold row assembly into sampling::speculative_prefix shared by engine and toy tests. Original q input creation order, target temperature->topK->topP policy, accepted/final/valid published ports and order, existing Graph executor, categorical RNG and Snapshot publication contract retained.
checks: Actual tinyV3 Graph m0/K2/K4 uses one distinct p_i and q_i per conditional, proposal_i, independent acceptance identity_i, and one final identity for mutually exclusive residual_i / all-accepted p_m bonus.

A finite deterministic Philox-address search picks one witness for each first/middle rejection position and all accepted:1+3+5 actual replay witnesses per backend; every row decision and final ID matches the independent F64 route-draw oracle. This is conformance, not measured sample-frequency confidence.
Real host select_sampled_prefix agrees with an independent scalar prefix walk for quota1/2/m+1 and optional EOS, leaving the final output pending. Actual allocated draw range is2m+1 including m0.
Bad unselected column in later q and last target row cannot be ignored merely because an earlier position rejected; invalid results are unusable, and valid same-invocation retry recovers.
Malformed key-row/proposal-row cold ports are refused before execution.
limits: The exact acceptance/residual proof targets the supplied normalized verifier conditional distributions. Different actual target row widths can have legal floating differences; no exact equality to ordinary T1 distribution or same-seed generated IDs is asserted.

The toy uses actual supplied proposal IDs and already-policy-normalized q_i, as its explicit component input; original real engine proposal generation, threshold decisions, cancellation and cache restoration use their separately recorded integration evidence.
No new large statistical benchmark, new task-intelligence threshold, whole-codec/model/platform Cartesian matrix or source weight acquisition.
